Decision: Use Django as the primary web framework
Reason: The original proposal expected rapid full-stack development
AlternativesConsidered: React with a separate API; Flask
Impact: Retained as historical proposal evidence but not used by the implemented application

Decision: Implement explainable lost-found item matching as the intelligent function
Reason: It directly addresses the project brief and can be evaluated with labelled examples
AlternativesConsidered: Image classification; external generative AI API
Impact: The implemented matcher remains deterministic and requires human confirmation

Decision: Use Next.js, React, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Mongoose for the implemented application
Reason: The integrated typed stack supports pages APIs validation and document persistence without a separate service deployment
AlternativesConsidered: Django; React with a separate API
Impact: Defines the implemented architecture and deployment model

Decision: Use five local course-appropriate WebP illustrations
Reason: Local assets avoid external tracking broken third-party URLs and unnecessary runtime image services
AlternativesConsidered: Remote stock images; an external image API
Impact: Adds contextual visuals without adding a dependency or external data flow

Decision: Use dependency-free CSS conic-gradient doughnut charts in Administrator Overview
Reason: The three sections need quick visual comparison while the existing accessible totals remain the source of truth
Impact: Improves overview readability without increasing the dependency surface

Decision: Decode rotate and re-encode uploaded JPEG PNG and WebP files with Sharp
Reason: Re-encoding removes retained EXIF metadata and normalises accepted images
AlternativesConsidered: Store the original upload; client-only processing
Impact: Reduces privacy risk while preserving the existing upload workflow

Decision: Use one shared strict JSON request reader with a 16 KB limit
Reason: Bounded parsing and consistent errors replace repeated request-body implementations
Impact: Reduces duplication and limits oversized JSON requests

Decision: Apply process-local rate limits to authentication member writes and privileged writes
Reason: The course project needs basic abuse resistance without production-scale infrastructure
AlternativesConsidered: No rate limits; external Redis-backed rate limiting
Impact: Protects sensitive operations while keeping setup simple and documented

Decision: Provide an idempotent reference-data bootstrap command
Reason: Fresh databases need repeatable categories and campus locations without overwriting administrator edits
Impact: Improves setup repeatability and preserves existing records

Decision: Make legacy external photo URL cleanup a dry-run audit by default
Reason: Historical data must be inspected safely before any database mutation
AlternativesConsidered: Automatic deletion; keeping unreviewed external URLs forever
Impact: Allows measured cleanup with an explicit apply option and optimistic concurrency

Decision: Evaluate matching with a separate labelled synthetic dataset
Reason: The intelligent feature needs reproducible precision recall F1 accuracy and top-match evidence
AlternativesConsidered: Only unit examples; a trained model benchmark
Impact: Produces transparent course-level evidence and documents dataset limitations
